title: Fractional CIO
description: The IT leadership function, delivered on a defined cadence. Vendor management, budgeting and forecasting, policy creation, standardization, and quarterly business reviews. Priced by client size and complexity — not by hours.

title: GRC as a Service
description: A recurring compliance program with defined deliverables and monthly reporting cadence. Framework alignment, risk register maintenance, policy lifecycle, control monitoring, and audit preparation — structured as an annual cycle, not a once-a-year scramble.

title: AI Governance & Enablement
description: Employees are already using AI. Company data is already leaving the organization. Frontline builds the policy and the technical enforcement layer — RMM, MDM, firewall, identity, CASB — inside your existing stack. Policy without enforcement is a document; enforcement without policy is arbitrary blocking users route around. We deliver both.

title: Managed Services
description: Infrastructure support for the environments Frontline governs. The advisory relationship is what makes this effective: we support environments we designed, documented, and standardized. Priced per endpoint or per user.
